name: VRM_SOURCE_DOC_TYPES_B_
description: VRM_SOURCE_DOC_TYPES_B contains definition of document types from source applications that VRM application integrates with. For examples, Sales Order from Oracle Order Management application, Service Contract from Oracle Service Contracts application. Document types can be defined in case for an integrating with deploying company's legacy applications.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document type.

columns.name: EXTRACT_TIME_FRAME
columns.description: Number of days for which extract program should pull the system data prior to the end date provided for extract run.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of a document type.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the application to which the transaction entity belongs to. Foreign key to the FND applications table.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: A yes or no flag that indicates if the document is active.

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS
columns.description: A Yes or No flag that indicates validation status of a document type where Y indicates valid and N indicates invalid document type.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Document type code from the source system.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: DEFAULT_SATIS_MEASURE_MODEL
columns.description: Default satisfaction measurement model to be used when the revenue rule is not provided from the source product.

columns.name: DEFAULT_REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the revenue scheduling rule. This rule needs to be defaulted on the performance obligation line if no rule is provided by the source application.

columns.name: DEFAULT_REVISION_INTENT_CODE
columns.description: Default revision intent for the source document type. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_REVISION_INTENT_TYPE.

columns.name: DEFAULT_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Default immaterial change type for the source document type. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_TYPE.

columns.name: ALLOW_REVENUE_LINE_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: A column heading in the Manage Source Document Types page that indicates whether the source document lines of the source document type can be updated using a REST service. Valid values are Y, N, or blank. Blank means No.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
